# even-or-odd-number

By using this module you can  find weathe the number is even or odd or none

# Install

```bash
$ npm i even-or-odd-number

```

# usage

Importing module
```js
   const  even_or_odd = require('even-or-odd-number') 
```

To find Even number or not
```js
     even_or_odd.is_even(number) // return true if even else return false
```

To find Odd number or not
```js
     even_or_odd.is_odd(number) // return true if odd else return false
```

To find Event or Odd 
```js
     even_or_odd.is_even_or_odd(number) // return  even if number is event or odd id number is odd else return none
```
